blockers: THINK_AGAIN_CONTEXT_MISSING: The failure reflection does not re-present any of the five cards or their readings. It tells the child to compare the same week's data again, but the scored UI has been completely replaced and only the result, meter, questions, and answer buttons remain. This violates the adopted Gate G implementation and makes the required two-axis reflection substantially memory-dependent.
high: VISUAL_FAILURE_CONSEQUENCE_INCOMPLETE: The promised failure visualization is not implemented as designed. The pre-commit screen has no reservoir meter to establish a before-state, and the failure screen does not render the selected sector/icon at all, so neither a visible meter transition nor the specified unchanged sector state can be observed.

failure_codes.finding: The reflecting branch claims to show the same week's data again but renders none of the five disclosed readings. The child must answer both reflection questions from memory, contradicting game_spec_v1.json failure_reflection and the adopted t5 system_reaction. The QA harness only checks that reflectSector, reflectDepth, and canContinueReflection identifiers exist, so its 29/29 result does not cover this defect.

The initial playing branch renders no reservoir meter, while the failure branch first introduces a meter at its post-commit value and omits the selected sector/icon entirely. Therefore the designed 'decline slows but does not stop' transition and 'selected sector remains unchanged' visual consequence are not actually observable.
